core_categories: Dental Supplies; Medical Supplies; Veterinary Supplies; Laboratory Equipment; Pharmaceuticals; Personal Protective Equipment
specialty_focus: Darby Group Companies is a healthcare investment and distribution organization, anchored by its flagship business, Darby Dental Supply, one of the largest national distributors of dental merchandise, equipment, and technology services. It supplies over 50,000 products to dental practices, DSOs, and government institutions, focusing on dental consumables, equipment lifecycle management, surgical specialties, and PPE. The company does not specifically deal in wearable medical devices.
